description: Ground-truth annotations and category definitions for FireWatch-AI Robustness Testing Suite

smoke_no_fire.description: Dense smoke plumes without visible open flames (testing whether smoke triggers false fire alarm)

autumn_foliage.description: Yellow, orange, and red autumn forest canopies (testing color-histogram false positives)

orange_sunsets.description: Golden-hour sunsets and sunrises behind forest horizons mimicking wildfire glow

industrial_smoke.description: Factory chimneys, cooling tower steam, and industrial plumes mimicking wildfires

campfires.description: Small-scale contained fires, campfires, or controlled burns in forested settings

forest_fires.description: Active crown and surface wildfire blazes with obvious flame illumination

green_forests.description: Standard lush green forest canopies and aerial views without smoke or fire

low_light.description: Nocturnal, dusk, or heavy overcast conditions challenging contrast and brightness sensitivity
